name: Scheduler RecoveryPlan proposal (IC-SCH-004)
purpose: Versioned PLAN proposal bound to one world, one source snapshot revision and one base schedule version, carrying candidate schedules, ObjectiveProfile, comparison, counterfactual references and rationale.
authority_level: Scheduler PLAN proposal only; no validation certificate, approval, activation or execution authority
security_classification: Internal manufacturing planning proposal; no credentials or hidden Simulator Oracle state

semantics.identity: recovery_plan_id, incident_id, world_id, source_snapshot.snapshot_revision and base_schedule_version are opaque and compared unchanged; content_digest binds the exact proposal content, it is not a signature or a validator certificate.
semantics.world: world_id is explicit; a plan, its candidates and every validation_result binding must carry the same world and snapshot revision as the snapshot it cites.
semantics.authority: PLAN only: assignments are PLANNED, never ACTUAL; a payload cannot activate, approve or execute itself.
semantics.validation: validation_result is the producer's unattested report. Eligibility needs an independent validation bound to world, snapshot revision and candidate at the execution boundary (planner is not validator).
semantics.completeness: Predicted objectives, solve timing, stability, counterfactual and rationale are NOT_COMPUTED, NOT_RUN or NOT_AVAILABLE unless a real producer computed them; fixtures carry DEVELOPMENT_FIXTURE provenance.
